effect_description_eng:
[On Play] By trashing 1 card with the [Blue Flare] trait or [Twilight] trait in your hand, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.)
[On Deletion] Reveal the top card of your deck. If that card has the [Blue Flare] trait or [Twilight] trait, add it to your hand. Trash the rest.
